TITLE: Golf Carts for Sale — Inventory Updated Daily | Alaska Golf Carts

DIRECT ANSWER:
Alaska Golf Carts is an Alaska statewide golf cart dealership serving
communities with statewide delivery — from Southcentral Alaska (Anchorage, Wasilla,
Palmer) and the Kenai Peninsula & Prince William Sound (Kenai, Soldotna, Homer, Seward, Kodiak) to Interior Alaska (Fairbanks, North Pole,
Delta Junction), Southeast Alaska (Juneau, Ketchikan, Sitka), and Northern, Arctic & Western Alaska (Nome, Kotzebue,
Bethel, Utqiagvik). The company sells new and
used golf carts, electric vehicles, street-legal LSVs, and lifted carts from 13 authorized
brands. Inventory is updated daily at 10:55 PM ET. Prices start around $5,000 for used carts
and $9,995 for new models. Financing is available at 0% APR for up to 48 months. Call
1-888-840-4490 to speak with a sales representative.

MAIN CONTENT:
Alaska Golf Carts sells great-priced golf carts with inventory refreshed every day.
The dealership carries both new and pre-owned golf carts in electric, gas, and street-legal
configurations. Models range from 2-passenger golf course carts to 6-passenger family vehicles.
Lifted golf carts with suspension upgrades are available. All 13 major brands are stocked.

Top-selling brands include Denago (Rover XL, Nomad XL), EZGO (RXV, TXT), Evolution (D5 Ranger 4,
D5 Maverick 6), Club Car (DS, Tempo, Precedent), and Yamaha (Drive 2, G29).

New golf carts are sold at MSRP pricing. Used golf carts are inspected and serviced
before sale. The dealership accepts trade-ins at all locations.

TITLE: Golf Cart Financing — 0% APR Up to 48 Months | Alaska Golf Carts

DIRECT ANSWER:
Alaska Golf Carts offers golf cart financing through six lending partners. Rates
start at 0% APR with terms up to 48 months. Applications are processed quickly, often
within minutes. Financing is available for new carts, used carts, street-legal LSVs,
and NEVs. Call 1-888-840-4490 to discuss options.

FINANCING PARTNERS:
1. Sheffield Financial (BBT) — Prequalify with no credit impact
2. BLI Heartland — Rent-to-own program for golf cart ownership
3. DLL Financial Solutions — Low APR, no hidden fees
4. Roadrunner / Octane — Consumer financing with fast decisions
5. Univest Capital — Business and commercial financing solutions
6. Dealer Direct — Buy now, pay later program

HOW TO APPLY:
Call 1-888-840-4490 to apply from anywhere in Alaska. Applications can also
be submitted online through each lending partner's portal. Approval decisions are
typically returned in minutes.

QUESTIONS ANSWERED:
- What credit score do I need? Most programs accept a range of credit profiles; call to discuss.
- Can I finance a used cart? Yes, most partners finance both new and used golf carts.
- Is 0% APR available? Yes, through select programs with qualified credit.

TITLE: Golf Cart Service Area — Alaska Statewide Across communities statewide across Alaska | Alaska Golf Carts

DIRECT ANSWER:
Alaska Golf Carts provides Alaska statewide service to communities statewide across alaska. Rather than
operating physical storefronts, the company sells new and used golf carts, offers
financing, and delivers statewide to any Alaska address. Call 1-888-840-4490.

SERVICE REGIONS (statewide delivery to communities statewide across Alaska):

1. Southcentral Alaska
   Metros: Anchorage, Eagle River, Wasilla, Palmer, Girdwood, Talkeetna
   Boroughs/Areas: Municipality of Anchorage, Matanuska-Susitna Borough
   Corridors: the Glenn Highway, the Parks Highway

2. Kenai Peninsula & Prince William Sound
   Metros: Kenai, Soldotna, Homer, Seward, Kodiak, Valdez, Cordova
   Boroughs/Areas: Kenai Peninsula Borough, Kodiak Island Borough, Chugach Census Area
   Corridors: the Seward Highway, the Sterling Highway

3. Interior Alaska
   Metros: Fairbanks, North Pole, Delta Junction, Tok, Nenana, Healy
   Boroughs/Areas: Fairbanks North Star Borough, Denali Borough, Southeast Fairbanks Census Area, Yukon-Koyukuk Census Area
   Corridors: the Parks Highway, the Richardson Highway, the Steese Highway

4. Southeast Alaska (Inside Passage)
   Metros: Juneau, Ketchikan, Sitka, Petersburg, Wrangell, Haines, Skagway, Craig
   Boroughs/Areas: City and Borough of Juneau, City and Borough of Sitka, Ketchikan Gateway Borough, Petersburg Borough, City and Borough of Wrangell, Haines Borough, Prince of Wales-Hyder Census Area, Hoonah-Angoon Census Area
   Corridors: the Alaska Marine Highway, the Klondike Highway

5. Northern, Arctic & Western Alaska
   Metros: Utqiagvik (Barrow), Nome, Kotzebue, Bethel, Dillingham, Unalaska (Dutch Harbor)
   Boroughs/Areas: North Slope Borough, Northwest Arctic Borough, Nome Census Area, Bethel Census Area, Dillingham Census Area, Aleutians East Borough, Aleutians West Census Area
   Corridors: the Dalton Highway, the Alaska Marine Highway

STATE SERVED: Alaska (statewide, communities statewide across alaska)
STATEWIDE DELIVERY: Yes, delivery available to any Alaska address.

TITLE: Golf Cart FAQ — Buying, Financing & Street-Legal Questions | Alaska Golf Carts

Q: How much does a golf cart cost at Alaska Golf Carts?
A: New golf carts start at approximately $9,995. Used and pre-owned golf carts typically
range from $4,500 to $12,000 depending on brand, age, condition, and features. Street-legal
LSVs and lifted models may cost more. Call 1-888-840-4490 for current pricing on specific units.

Q: What brands of golf carts does Alaska Golf Carts sell?
A: Alaska Golf Carts is an authorized dealer for 13 brands: American Custom Golf Carts,
Bintelli, Club Car, COLEMAN, COLUMBIA, CRICKET, Denago, Evolution, EZGO (E-Z-GO), Icon,
Star EV, Tara, and Yamaha.

Q: Does Alaska Golf Carts offer financing?
A: Yes. Financing is available through six partners including Sheffield Financial, BLI Heartland,
DLL Financial Solutions, Roadrunner/Octane, Univest Capital, and Dealer Direct. Options include
0% APR programs, rent-to-own, and business financing. Terms up to 48 months.

Q: What is a street-legal golf cart (LSV)?
A: A Low Speed Vehicle (LSV) is a golf cart that meets federal safety standards (FMVSS 500)
for road use on streets with posted limits of 35 mph or less. Required equipment includes
headlights, taillights, turn signals, brake lights, mirrors, seat belts, horn, and VIN.
Alaska Golf Carts stocks LSVs from multiple brands.

Q: What is the difference between electric and gas golf carts?
A: Electric golf carts run on battery packs (typically 36V, 48V, or 72V lithium-ion or
lead-acid). They are quieter, produce no exhaust, and have lower per-mile energy costs.
Gas golf carts use small combustion engines and are preferred where charging is inconvenient
or for longer-range use. Both types are available statewide from Alaska Golf Carts.

Q: Does Alaska Golf Carts deliver across Alaska?
A: Yes. Statewide delivery is available to any address in Alaska. Contact 1-888-840-4490
to get a delivery quote to your address.

Q: Can I trade in my golf cart?
A: Yes. Trade-ins are accepted anywhere in Alaska. Call 1-888-840-4490 to discuss your
trade-in value.

Q: What areas does Alaska Golf Carts serve?
A: Alaska Golf Carts provides Alaska statewide service to communities across the entire state, including
Southcentral Alaska (Anchorage, Wasilla, Palmer), the Kenai Peninsula & Prince William Sound
(Kenai, Soldotna, Homer, Seward, Kodiak, Valdez), Interior Alaska (Fairbanks, North Pole,
Delta Junction), Southeast Alaska / the Inside Passage (Juneau, Ketchikan, Sitka), and Northern,
Arctic & Western Alaska (Utqiagvik, Nome, Kotzebue, Bethel, Dillingham).

Q: Does Alaska Golf Carts service and repair golf carts?
A: Yes. Service offerings include routine maintenance, battery diagnostics and replacement,
motor and controller repair, brake service, electrical diagnostics, body repair, and warranty
service for all carried brands.

Q: How often is the inventory updated?
A: The inventory feed is refreshed daily at 10:55 PM Eastern Time. Prices and availability
reflect the most recent update.

TITLE: About Alaska Golf Carts — Alaska Statewide Golf Cart Dealer

DIRECT ANSWER:
Alaska Golf Carts is one of the largest Alaska statewide golf cart dealerships in
Alaska. The company provides statewide service and delivery to communities statewide across Alaska,
carries 13 authorized brands, and maintains daily-updated inventory of 500+ golf carts. The
dealership specializes in great-priced new and used golf carts, electric vehicles,
street-legal LSVs, and lifted carts.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:
Alaska Golf Carts offers great-to-the-public pricing on golf carts from all
major manufacturers. The dealership serves residential communities, golf courses, gated
communities, retirement communities, resorts, commercial properties, and individual buyers
across all of Alaska — from Southeast Alaska to the Arctic.

The company's inventory is updated every day at 10:55 PM ET, reflecting accurate current
stock levels and pricing. Multiple financing partners allow customers to purchase with
monthly payments, including 0% APR options.
